messages.text: Starting to put together the Q4 DR test plan. Proposing we do the failover drill the weekend of Oct 24. Anyone see conflicts with that?
Oct 24 should be fine on my side. Priya leaves Oct 9 though, so any runbook knowledge she holds needs to be captured before then.
Good point. I'll ask her to walk through the MarketDataFeed failover steps next week and record it. Last time the secondary vendor connection took forever to come up.
Quick question on scope: are we including DocVault in this round? It's standard tier but compliance leans on it for client records.
I'd include it. DocVault depends on AuthSSO, so if we fail over SSO we can validate that dependency chain at the same time.
Agreed. I'll add DocVault restore and a read/write smoke test to the plan. RTO target of 4 hours for now, we can revisit.
Can I own the smoke test scripts? I can write something that uploads, retrieves, and checksums a few test docs, using dummy files only.
Yes please, that'd be great. Dummy data only, nothing from real client folders.
For MarketDataFeed, do we want to replay captured exchange data in DR or connect to live vendor feeds? Replay is safer but doesn't prove the vendor cutover.
I'd like to do both. Replay first to verify ingestion, then a short live window Saturday morning when volume is low. Need to loop in Trading so nobody is surprised.
PricingSvc sits right downstream, so we should check prices come out sane after cutover. I can add a comparison check against the primary.
Nice. Let's put that in as a pass/fail gate rather than an eyeball check.
Draft plan will be in the it-ops wiki by Friday. Please comment directly on the doc by next Wednesday so we can send it to Linda Brandt's team for sign-off.
Sounds good, will have script outlines in there by Monday.
